jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Account Executive (Italian-speaking) (m/f/d) Your Role

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. When the pipeline dries out, you go on the hunt for new deals yourself.

What to expect

 * Inbound demos: 8-16 qualified demo calls per day

 * Quota ownership: clear monthly and quarterly targets

 * Pipeline management: Run structured follow-ups and keep your CRM clean.

 * Sales Motion: Help sharpen our sales motion as we scale fast

Who We're Looking For

Must-haves

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

 * Proven closing track record along a structured funnel

 * High discipline, strong ownership, and a genuine hunger to earn

 * Natural communicator and storyteller

 * Native or C2 Italian and strong English.

Nice-to-haves

 * German language skills.

 * Experience selling to SMBs, ideally owner-led businesses.

 * Worked in a high-velocity inbound setup with short sales cycles.

 * Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.

 * Track record of self-sourcing deals through outbound when inbound is slow.

What We Offer

 * €70.000-€100.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Equity 

 * Unlimited budget with the right ROI

 * Daily lunch and dinner, plus drinks and snacks at our Vienna office

 * Relocation bonus (in case you want to stay in Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice 

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 45 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a demo simulation

 * 30 min chat to get to know the go-to-market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

You'll set the direction for both and decide where we place our bets. You'll also lead the team that delivers it.
